rows.label: tlk70000027_03_msg0001
rows.name:
Not only Knight Laura-sama, but even
Shin-sama, Iira's secret treasure, has
returned...

rows.label: tlk70000027_03_msg0002
rows.name:
Who would have thought I would
be here to witness such a
remarkable event in history?

rows.label: tlk70000027_03_msg0003
rows.name:
Laura-sama, Shin-sama, and of course
Adel-sama! Please continue to guide
this country!

rows.label: tlk70000027_03_msg0004
rows.name:
Nittle will etch your gallant figures
into memory and pass this historic
moment down through the ages!
